18266-death-and-after.title: Death--And After?
18266-death-and-after.creator: Unknown
18266-death-and-after.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Who does not remember the story of the Christian missionary in Britain, sitting one evening in the vast hall of a Saxon king, surrounded by his thanes, having come thither to preach the gospel of his Master; and as he spoke of life and death and immortality, a bird flew in through an unglazed window, circled the hall in its flight, and flew out once more into the darkness of the night.

24964-handbook-of-embroidery.title: Handbook Of Embroidery
24964-handbook-of-embroidery.creator: Unknown
24964-handbook-of-embroidery.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. We have abstained from giving any directions as to the tracing of designs upon material, for two sufficient reasons: firstly, that the Royal School of Art-Needlework has never supplied designs alone, or in any other form than as prepared work; and secondly, that having made experiments with all the systems that have been brought out for "stamping," ironing from transfer-papers, or with tracing powder, it has been found that designs can only be artistically and well traced on material by hand painting.

arxiv-2112-14802.title: Reliability-based topology optimization under random-field material model Journal: Here is the journal name
arxiv-2112-14802.creator: Trung Pham, Christopher Hoyle
arxiv-2112-14802.description: Abstract This paper presents an algorithm for reliability-based topology optimization of linear elastic continua under random-field material model. The modelling random field is discretized into a small number of random variables, and then the interested output is estimated by a stochastic response surface. A single-loop inverse-reliability algorithm is applied to reduce computational cost of reliability analysis.

arxiv-2205-06158.title: Direct optimization of BPX preconditioners
arxiv-2205-06158.creator: Vladimir Fanaskov, Ivan Oseledets
arxiv-2205-06158.description: Abstract We consider an automatic construction of locally optimal preconditioners for positive definite linear systems. To achieve this goal, we introduce a differentiable loss function that does not explicitly include the estimation of minimal eigenvalue. Nevertheless, the resulting optimization problem is equivalent to a direct minimization of the condition number.

arxiv-2301-12709.title: Solvent quality and solvent polarity in polypeptides
arxiv-2301-12709.creator: Cedrix J. Dongmo Foumthuim, Achille Giacometti
arxiv-2301-12709.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Cedrix J. Dongmo Foumthuim, Achille Giacometti. Using molecular dynamics and thermodynamic integration, we report on the solvation process in water and in cyclohexane of seven polypeptides (GLY, ALA, ILE, ASN, LYS, ARG, GLU). The polypeptides are selected to cover the full hydrophobic scale while varying their chain length from tri- to undeca-homopeptides provide indications on possible non-additivity effects as well as the role of the peptide backbone in the overall stability of the polypeptides.

arxiv-2310-09400.title: Collaborative Semantic Alignment in Recommendation Systems DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2310-09400.creator: Chen Wang, Liangwei Yang, Zhiwei Liu, Xiaolong Liu, Mingdai Yang, Yueqing Liang, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2310-09400.description: Abstract . Traditional recommender systems primarily leverage identity-based (ID) representations for users and items, while the advent of pre-trained language models (PLMs) has introduced rich semantic modeling of item descriptions. However, PLMs often overlook the vital collaborative filtering signals, leading to challenges in merging collaborative and semantic representation spaces and fine-tuning semantic representations for better alignment with warm-start conditions.

arxiv-2311-02989.title: Phase mixing of propagating Alfvén waves in a single-fluid partially ionized solar plasma
arxiv-2311-02989.creator: M. McMurdo, I. Ballai, G. Verth, A. Alharbi, V. Fedun
arxiv-2311-02989.description: Abstract Phase mixing of Alfvén waves is one of the most promising mechanisms for heating of the solar atmosphere. The damping of waves in this case requires small transversal scales, relative to the magnetic field direction. Here this requirement is achieved by considering a transversal inhomogeneity in the equilibrium plasma density profile.

arxiv-2501-05181.title: Text Data Analysis of Maternal Narratives: Albanian Women in Italy
arxiv-2501-05181.creator: Eleonora Miaci a and Emiliano Seri b
arxiv-2501-05181.description: Abstract Despite growing interest in migration studies, research on motherhood among migrant women in Italy remains limited. This study contributes to the literature by examining the family trajectories of Albanian women in Italy, exploring how their migration patterns and experiences have shaped these life aspects.

arxiv-2501-12523.title: Federated Discrete Denoising Diffusion Model for Molecular Generation with OpenFL
arxiv-2501-12523.creator: Kevin Ta, Patrick Foley, Mattson Thieme, Abhishek Pandey, Prashant Shah
arxiv-2501-12523.description: Abstract Generating unique molecules with biochemically desired properties to serve as viable drug candidates is a difficult task that requires specialized domain expertise. In recent years, diffusion models have shown promising results in accelerating the drug design process through AI-driven molecular generation. However, training these models requires massive amounts of data, which are often isolated in proprietary silos.

arxiv-2506-19161.title: Holomorphic Unified Field Theory of Gravity and the Standard Model
arxiv-2506-19161.creator: J. W. Moffat, E. J. Thompson
arxiv-2506-19161.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. W. Moffat, E. J. Thompson. We present a single holomorphic framework in which gravity, all Standard Model interactions, and their couplings to charges and currents emerge from one geometric action on a four‐complex dimensional manifold.

arxiv-2507-21682.title: Probabilistic cosmological inference on HI tomographic data 2015 Probabilistic cosmological inference on HI tomographic data – References
arxiv-2507-21682.creator: Sambatra Andrianomena
arxiv-2507-21682.description: Abstract We explore the possibility of retrieving cosmological information along with its inherent uncertainty from 21-cm tomographic data at intermediate redshift. The first step in our approach consists of training an encoder, composed of several three dimensional convolutional layers, to cast the neutral hydrogen 3D data into a lower dimension latent space.

arxiv-2512-23417.title: Precisely determining the ground state mass of Spin-3/2 Ω c ​ c ​ c \Omega_{ccc} baryon from Lattice QCD
arxiv-2512-23417.creator: M. Padmanath
arxiv-2512-23417.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by M. Padmanath. We present the most precise determination to date of the ground-state masses of the triply charmed baryons with both parities, obtained by continuum extrapolation and fully addressing the systematic uncertainties. The calculations are performed on six N f = 2 + 1 + 1 N_{f}=2+1+1 HISQ ensembles, generated by the MILC collaboration, with two complementary setups for the valence charm action, one using the HISQ action and the other using the overlap fermion action.

arxiv-2602-05071.title: Optimal Harvesting in Stream Networks: Maximizing Biomass and Yield
arxiv-2602-05071.description: Abstract In this study, we develop a metapopulation model framework to identify optimal harvesting strategies for a population in a stream network. We consider two distinct optimization objectives: maximization of total biomass and maximization of total yield, under the constraint of a fixed total harvesting effort.

pmc-10704983.creator: Philip J. Senter
pmc-10704983.description: BackgroundRange of motion in the forelimb of the Upper Cretaceous theropod dinosaur Mononykus olecranus, a member of the family Alvarezsauridae, has previously been investigated. However, the method used to investigate range of motion at the shoulder in M. olecranus did not follow the standardized procedure used in subsequent studies.

pmc-11451228.creator: Stefan Dyksma, Michael Pester
pmc-11451228.description: BackgroundSulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB) are frequently encountered in anoxic-to-oxic transition zones, where they are transiently exposed to microoxic or even oxic conditions on a regular basis. This can be marine tidal sediments, microbial mats, and freshwater wetlands like peatlands. In the latter, a cryptic but highly active sulfur cycle supports their anaerobic activity.

pmc-11644383.description: The emergence of new technologies focusing on “computer vision” has contributed significantly to the assessment of fruit quality. pmc-12418556.creator: Nedim Leto, Elisabeth Farbu, Paul Barach, Michael Busch, Helene Lund, Conrad Arnfinn Bjørshol, Martin Kurz, Annette Fromm, Øyvind Østerås, Linn Therese Hagen, Thomas Werner Lindner
pmc-12418556.description: Background and aimsResearch on the importance of the Emergency Medical Dispatch Centre (EMDC) role in reducing the time delays for patients with acute ischaemic stroke (AIS) is limited. This study aimed to analyse how Norwegian EMDCs’ accurate suspicions can impact the clinical care times in this patient group.

pmc-12484023.creator: Yuxin Xiang, Chang Tong, Dan Sun, Zhisheng Liu
pmc-12484023.description: PurposeTic disorders (TD) are common childhood neurodevelopmental conditions, characterized by diverse manifestations, leading to misdiagnosis and delayed therapy. Timely identification of TD and access to care can improve clinical outcomes. This retrospective study characterizes clinical features and initial pharmacotherapy in newly diagnosed pediatric TD.MethodThis retrospective cohort study included 805 newly diagnosed pediatric TD patients.

pmc-12651179.title: Zein–Curcumin Composite Edible Films for Intelligent Packaging: A Natural pH-Sensing Indicator to Monitor Sea Bream Freshness
pmc-12651179.creator: Burcu Demirtas, Beyza Keser, Serpil Tural, Latife Betül Gül, Ilay Yilmaz, Mahmut Ekrem Parlak, Ayşe Neslihan Dündar, Maria D’Elia, Luca Rastrelli, Furkan Turker Saricaoglu
pmc-12651179.description: This study developed and characterized zein-based edible films enriched with curcumin as natural pH-sensitive indicators for monitoring fish freshness. pmc-13624556.creator: Wenhan Sung, Tianshu Li, Shinji Takeoka
pmc-13624556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionLipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are widely used as drug delivery systems (DDS) for the intracellular delivery of gene-editing tools such as the clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)/CRISPR-associated protein 9 (Cas9) system. Previously, a lysine-headgroup cationic lipid (K3C16) was reported to exhibit high biocompatibility and cellular internalization via plasma membrane fusion when formulated as liposomes, suggesting its potential as a low-toxicity gene delivery material.
